round_1.summary: The science reproduces. On a fresh seed (20261103) with 5 subjects disjoint from the worker's 6 people, 10 legs and 217 stances, the source ankle angle and moment are dorsiflexion-positive with internal moments, as the worker found. A new kinematic test that uses no moments and no physiology agrees: foot pitch from the plate force seen in the lab and calcn frames equals hip_flexion + knee_angle + ankle_angle (ankle coefficient 0.83-1.18 in 10 of 10 legs). My code reproduces the worker's BT02 numbers exactly. The publisher files are unchanged and the errata are accurate. Returned for review-sheet rule fixes only: one figure is wider than 4.5 in, some figure text is under 10 pt, the reply line shows a task ID, and the handoff timestamp is in the future. No scientific approval is implied.

checks.name: Fresh-seed reproduction of the sign
checks.evidence: Seed 20261103, numpy default_rng permutation over (phase, subject) units excluding the worker's people BT02/BT07/BT10/BT11/BT20/BT24 and Phase1And2/BT01 (README invalid torques); one random level/uphill/weighted walking condition each. Drawn: Phase3/BT21 normal_walk_1_1_1-2_on, Phase1And2/BT16 normal_walk_2_1_2-5_on, Phase1And2/BT03 incline_walk_1_2_up5_off, Phase1And2/BT14 incline_walk_2_1_up10_on, Phase1And2/BT13 normal_walk_1_1_2-5_on; 0 redraws. Frame: insole stance force up and CoP heel to toe in 217/217 stances; insole and plate force norms equal to 6.4e-12 N. Lever arm (generic talus point (0.04877, 0.04195) m in calcn, internal toes-up-positive estimate / README w/ exo mass): source slope 0.949-0.989 in 10/10 legs, correlation 0.985-0.999, stance-mean sign agreement 217/217; grid a_x in {0, 0.05, 0.10} m x a_y in {0, 0.04, 0.08} m gives 0.66-1.67, all positive. Push-off net work (70-100 % stance): positive in 217/217 stances from the publisher power column and from source moment x d(angle)/dt (medians 0.22-0.46 J/kg). Angle falls from 70 % stance to plate toe-off in 217/217 stances (median -18 to -30 deg). Toe walk minus heel walk (same subjects): ankle lower in 10/10 legs (-0.8 to -15.6 deg) with measured CoP 9.4-17.3 cm further forward. Ankle moment_filt_bio equals moment_filt exactly (max difference 0.0) in 10/10 legs.

checks.name: New kinematic chain test (no moments, no physiology)
checks.evidence: Foot pitch was taken as the angle between the same force vector in the calcn frame (insole_sim x, y) and in the lab sagittal plane (grf, fore-aft axis and sign from the treadmill CoP travel), on stance frames with Fy > 0.2 body weight. Free regression pitch = c + b_h hip_flexion + b_k knee_angle + b_a ankle_angle: b_a 0.83-1.18, b_h 0.94-1.18, b_k 0.80-0.95 in 10/10 legs. Fixed unit-coefficient chain residual SD: 1.2-3.2 deg with the ankle as published versus 9.4-18.4 deg with it negated. So the published ankle angle rotates the foot toes-up about the same axis as hip flexion and knee extension, which is OpenSim gait2392 dorsiflexion-positive. Disclosure: my first run assumed lab x is fore-aft and gave inconsistent results; the lab CoP actually travels along z (0.32-0.48 m per stance) and barely along x (under 0.03 m). The script records the fix in a comment.

checks.name: Alternative explanations
checks.evidence: (a) README about a different file: lines 90-91 sit under GENERAL NOTES and name the biological OpenSim DOFs, which are the angle/velocity/moment/power files; the exo has no ankle channel (power_exo ankle is 0, bio = net). The statement cannot refer to the exo coordinates. (b) Exo versus biological coordinates: exo knee encoder vs OpenSim knee_angle r = +0.966 to +0.994 (9 legs) and exo hip vs hip_flexion r = -0.974 to -0.992 (10 legs); this matches README 'exo extension positive' and 'knee extension positive'. One leg (Phase1And2/BT03 L, an exo-off trial) has a flat knee encoder (r = 0); it is not used. (c) Foot-frame versus lab-frame CoP: the lever arm uses only calcn-frame force and CoP, so it is independent of the lab axes. The calcn frame rotates with the foot (pitch range -43 to +19 deg against the lab), so it is a real foot frame and not a re-labeled lab frame. (d) Sign flip in the force data itself: stance plate Fy is positive and the mean of both plates' vertical force / g is 0.99-1.02 x the README w/ exo mass in 5/5 trials, so the forces act on the body and are in N. (e) External rather than internal moment with plantarflexion-positive angle: excluded by the chain test (angle sign fixed without moments) together with the lever arm (moment sign relative to the angle).
